description.value: The Haida Way Motor Inn is Port McNeill's largest hospitality complex, offering 70 guestrooms and suites on the northern end of Vancouver Island near the harbour and BC Ferries terminal. The property includes a full-service restaurant, a lively pub, and a liquor store all on site, making it a convenient one-stop overnight for cyclists arriving by ferry or heading toward Port Hardy. It is approved by BCAA and Tourism BC.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website content is fully fetched and corroborates the OSM record on address, phone, and property details. A 'Dry room' and 'Guest Laundry facilities' are explicitly listed in the business travel amenities, and free wireless internet is confirmed both by the website and OSM tag internet_access=wlan. No explicit mention of secure bike storage or staff bike procedure is found anywhere in the website content, so those remain null.
concerns: Website alternates between 'Haida Way Motor Inn' (OSM name, used on front page) and 'Haida Way Hotel' (used on contact and business travel pages) — minor branding inconsistency.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Established 70-room motel near the Port McNeill ferry terminal with on-site dining, laundry, a dry room, and free Wi-Fi — a solid overnight option for touring cyclists on northern Vancouver Island. Secure bike storage is unconfirmed and should be followed up.
enrichment_extras.notes: Pets are welcome in the motel section per the policies page. Motel rooms include kitchen facilities. Continental breakfast is included in standard room rates.
